summary: This round's source change makes `uploadChatFile` cancel its server upload when writing chunks fails or is aborted, so staged files and reserved disk space are freed right away. The logic is correct and the call is made without the aborted signal, as it should be. The change is not ready because the temp test run fails. The new test "cancels the server upload when the client stops partway" causes an unhandled undici rejection that fails the vitest run. A temp test from another worktree (`tmp/pr2/...`) was also collected and fails to load. Because the run failed, the coverage gate also reports 7 uncovered lines.

findings.body: `onProgress: () => controller.abort()` aborts the signal synchronously, while undici is still finishing the response stream of the `uploads.write` call that just resolved. Vitest reports an unhandled rejection (`TypeError: Invalid state: ReadableStream is already closed`, ERR_INVALID_STATE) and attributes it to this test, so the run exits 1 even though all 25 tests pass. Abort at a point that does not race the finished response. For example, defer it (`setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 0)` from onProgress), or abort when the second `/rpc/uploads/write` request starts by using a fetch spy, as the retry tests do. Keep the assertions that the result is a ChatUploadCancelledError and that the staging directory is empty.

The temp run collected this file from a separate worktree under `tmp/pr2/`. It is not part of this change and fails to load: `Cannot find module .../tmp/pr2/node_modules/@tanishqkancharla/tandem-core/dist/TandemClient`. A failing temp run blocks approval. Make sure only this change's temp tests are collected. If the file belongs to this change, move it into `apps/electron/e2e/.tmp-tests/`. Otherwise keep the other worktree's `.tmp-tests` out of this review's collection, for example by moving that worktree outside this repository's `tmp/`, but do not delete another agent's work.

testRequests.target: packages/client/src/uploadChatFile.ts:49,51: when the cleanup `uploads.cancel` call fails after a failed upload, the failure is logged as 'Could not cancel upload:' and the original upload error is still returned
testRequests.rationale: This branch is new in this round and no test covers it. Extend the 'gives up after repeated failures' test to make `/rpc/uploads/cancel` fail as well, then assert the warning and the returned ChatUploadError.
